'''Naughlen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
In [[3643 BBY]] he was stationed on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] and together with [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] [[Weggland]] was defending [[Outpost Shylon]] from an Imperial attack led by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Kligton]] when [[Empire's Wrath|the apprentice]] of [[Darth Baras]] arrived on the scene. The apprentice was systematically dismantling the power base of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Rathari]] whom Kligton answered to and attacked his men when the General refused to switch sides. After Kligton and his soldiers were slain, Naughlen attempted to negotiate with the apprentice on behalf of himself and the garrison only to be slain by the Sith.

==Behind the scenes==
The Sith Warrior could choose to spare Naughlen and his men and his men or attack and kill them. If Naughlen and his men are spared, they will help the warrior defeat Rathari and his troops. After defeating Rathari and his forces, the warrior could choose to spare him for light side points or kill him.
